jobs.title: Credit Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Texas Heritage National Bank is a reputable financial institution committed to serving the banking needs of individuals and businesses across Texas. With a legacy of integrity, innovation, and community engagement, the bank offers a comprehensive range of financial products and services tailored to meet diverse customer requirements. Texas Heritage National Bank prides itself on fostering a collaborative work environment that values professionalism, continuous growth, and excellence in service delivery. As a forward-thinking organization, the bank emphasizes leveraging advanced technology and data-driven insights to maintain a competitive edge in the financial industry.

About The Role

The Credit Data Analyst position is a vital role within Texas Heritage National Bank, designed to support the bank’s risk management and credit assessment functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing the bank's loan portfolio, identifying risk patterns, and providing actionable insights to senior management. This role involves utilizing advanced data analysis tools and techniques to evaluate portfolio health, monitor credit quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. The analyst will work closely with the Chief Credit Officer and other stakeholders to develop risk models, prepare detailed reports, and support decision-making processes that safeguard the bank’s financial stability.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field. An advanced degree or professional certification such as CFA is preferred but not mandatory. Candidates should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in credit analysis, risk assessment, or related roles within the banking or financial services industry. Proficiency in data analysis software such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Tableau is essential. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication abilities are critical to success in this role. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and possess a proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

Responsibilities

Perform comprehensive data analysis using tools like pivot tables, V-Lookup, and advanced analytics software to evaluate the bank’s loan portfolio and identify underlying trends.
Assist the Chief Credit Officer in analyzing concentrations within the portfolio and preparing written assessments on risk exposure and portfolio health.
Develop and maintain financial models and spreadsheets to support risk modeling, scenario analysis, and credit decision-making processes.
Prepare detailed reports summarizing portfolio findings, risk assessments, and recommendations for management and the Board of Directors.
Ensure timely preparation of monthly Board reports, adhering to tight deadlines and maintaining accuracy and clarity in documentation.
Support compliance efforts by ensuring adherence to bank policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, and assist during audits and policy reviews.
Maintain accurate, organized files and records related to credit analysis, risk assessments, and portfolio performance.
Monitor market trends, economic indicators, and credit market conditions to inform risk assessments and strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with senior management, risk managers, and legal teams to facilitate informed analyses and effective risk mitigation strategies.
Adhere to internal controls, operational procedures, and risk management policies, including security protocols for fraud prevention, cash controls, and teller procedures.
Participate in ongoing training and development activities to stay updated on industry best practices, regulatory changes, and technological advancements.
Perform other duties as assigned by management to support the bank’s strategic objectives and operational needs.

Benefits

Texas Heritage National Bank offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include health insurance coverage, retirement savings plans, paid time off, and opportunities for career advancement. The bank promotes a positive work environment that encourages continuous learning, work-life balance, and recognition of individual contributions. Employees also have access to training programs, professional development resources, and a collaborative culture that values innovation and teamwork.

Equal Opportunity

Texas Heritage National Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe diversity enhances our organizational strength and drives our success, and we actively promote equal employment opportunities across all levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

University Health is a leading healthcare organization committed to providing exceptional patient care, innovative medical services, and advancing health research. With a strong emphasis on community health and wellness, University Health integrates cutting-edge technology, dedicated healthcare professionals, and comprehensive programs to serve diverse populations. Our mission is to improve health outcomes through quality care, education, and research, making a positive impact on the communities we serve.

About The Role

The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst at University Health plays a vital role in supporting the organization’s Risk Adjustment program. This position involves detailed data analysis, reporting, and medical record retrieval to ensure accurate risk adjustment and compliance with regulatory standards. The analyst collaborates with internal departments, provider networks, and external vendors to gather and analyze data, identify trends, and monitor key performance indicators related to Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) capture. The role is essential in enhancing risk adjustment outcomes, supporting medical record initiatives, and ensuring adherence to CMS requirements. The ideal candidate will utilize health informatics tools to support data validation, provider performance analysis, and regulatory reporting, contributing to the organization’s strategic goals of quality improvement and financial sustainability.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, health information management, or a related field is preferred. Candidates should possess a minimum of two (2) years of experience in healthcare data analysis, medical record retrieval, or related areas. Prior experience with Risk Adjustment, managed care, health plan operations, or healthcare analytics is highly desirable. Familiarity with healthcare data systems, electronic health records (EHRs), and medical record retrieval processes is advantageous. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytics tools is required. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong analytical skills, organizational abilities, and excellent communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with providers, vendors, and cross-functional teams is essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities

The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting the organization’s risk adjustment initiatives through various activities, including:

Analyzing healthcare data to identify trends and opportunities for improving risk adjustment outcomes.
Supporting Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) capture efforts by reviewing and validating data accuracy.
Coordinating with provider networks and external vendors to facilitate timely and accurate medical record retrieval.
Generating detailed reports and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators related to risk adjustment.
Assisting with medical record retrieval initiatives to ensure compliance with CMS and organizational standards.
Conducting provider performance analysis to identify areas for improvement and training opportunities.
Ensuring regulatory compliance through accurate and timely reporting to CMS and other governing bodies.
Collaborating with cross-departmental teams to support data validation and quality assurance processes.
Utilizing health informatics tools such as Microsoft Power BI or similar platforms for data visualization and reporting.

Benefits

University Health offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, dental and vision plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. We also provide a supportive work environment that encourages work-life balance, continuous learning, and career advancement. Our commitment to employee wellness and engagement ensures that team members are motivated and equipped to deliver exceptional healthcare services.

Equal Opportunity

University Health is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe diversity enriches our organization and enhances our ability to serve our community effectively. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and organizational needs.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - Southeast
jobs.description:
About Neo4j

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

At Neo4j, our Solution Engineers are pivotal to our company’s success. As a critical member of our regional go-to-market team, you will partner with our sales executives to showcase the value of our graph data platform and manage the technical aspects of the sales cycle. You will help organizations across industries such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Technology and Life Sciences understand the business and technical value of representing data using Neo4j graph database and analytics technology. You will grow as a thought leader in graphs and solve our customers’ high-value problems beyond traditional data solutions.

What Success Looks Like

Developing and honing subject matter expertise to effectively discern and understand the true needs of our customers, present technology solutions that target those needs, and all in all, demonstrate thought leadership and the value of Neo4j through platform and use case demonstrations, solution architecting, workshops, and conferences.
Meeting and exceeding regional revenue goals, as a result of helping Sales to qualify and validate opportunities from a technical perspective and accelerate the sales cycle and adoption of Neo4j.
Collaborating effectively with Sales, Professional Services, Product Management, etc to deliver continuous value to customers and ensure a seamless customer experience as they embark on the graph journey.

What You’ll Do

Confidently articulate the business and technical value of Neo4j to customers and prospects as a key technical advisor and advocate for our products and services
Actively drive and run the technology evaluation stage of the sales cycles.
Work across a number of opportunities in parallel and manage day-to-day activities such as opportunity qualification, technical discovery, presentations, platform and use case demonstrations, proof of value, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria.
Build and nurture rapport with customer stakeholders at all levels and be the trusted advisor to them to help them understand what they can achieve with Neo4j.
Co-create reference and solution architectures with our customers, including integrating Neo4j with their existing architecture and applications within a public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise environment.
Stay current on latest Neo4j capabilities, including but not limited to usage and integration with third-party tools and services.
Distill and communicate customer needs and product feedback to Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
Help drive demand through the participation in account-based marketing events as well as industry-known conferences and trade shows.
Lead by example and actively foster an environment of teamwork, transparency, creativity, and continuous improvement.
Travel as needed to assist in deal creation and closure, and provide support to your team as required.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of customer-facing experience in a similar capacity (Sales/Presales/Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, etc), ideally in a similar high-growth, scaling environment.
Experience working with different data technologies in either of the following areas: enterprise data architecture, data analytics, data science or cloud data architecture.
Working knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph, OrientDB, JanusGraph, etc) - a strong plus!
Hands-on experience and proficiency with relational (SQL) and/or NoSQL databases, and at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, C#.
Familitary with GenAI, LLM’s and Agentic AI a plus
Successful track record in designing, developing, and implementing data solutions in the public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise.
Ability to engage and communicate ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels through presentations, whiteboarding, and platform demonstrations.
Technical savviness and business acumen to translate technical concepts and patterns into valuable business outcomes.
Passion for learning new technologies (especially graphs!), developing new ways of data modeling, and spearheading change management.
An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to prioritize, pivot, and problem-solve.

The annual on target earnings range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This range is an estimate, and the actual on target earnings may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence.

Annual On Target Earnings Range

$200,000—$265,000 USD
